Actual filesystem UID/mode/xattr/rename/fsync durability, resource enforcement, containerd content-root headroom, clean installation, reboot/reconnection and full application recovery remain unproven and outside SOURCE.
No prior review report, defense, workflow status/export or run journal was consulted. No implementation source was edited.
observations: Actual Docker Go Info fields and CLI template execution were checked against primary upstream Moby and Docker CLI source. CPUCfsPeriod and CPUCfsQuota are the template fields; CpuCfsPeriod and CpuCfsQuota are JSON tags. IO observations use cgroup controllers and device mapping, with no fabricated Info fields.

The actual shell rejects malformed record count/sentinel, unsafe daemon identity tokens, projection control characters, absent/nonboolean resources, undeclared security options, endpoint overrides, missing roots, unsupported host/daemon scope, and invalid declared deployment scalars. Owned shell fixtures compare checkout/data-root trees and log fake mutations.

SOURCE storage admission checks host rw or controller ro access, ext4/XFS/Btrfs capability candidates, classic overlay2 XFS d_type and SOURCE-first sysfs/whole-disk device mapping. Controller validation additionally binds full CID, daemon root, Compose labels, running state, security, checkout and exact mounts. These observations do not prove persistence or enforcement.

Actual primary launcher pins explicit local endpoint, project, checkout, compose.yaml and /dev/null environment file, passes declared inputs through a cleared environment, and uses fixed startup, bootstrap, smoke, upgrade, observation and cleanup commands. The custom project/socket fixtures exercise this public journey. The launcher requires public Linux utilities plus POSIX shell and Docker/Compose, with no host Python/Bun/systemd prerequisite.

Startup constructors and CLI guards in dev, worker, installation_runtime, durable_runtime, run, install_server and resource consumers were inspected. Canonical shell capability admission is baked into the controller validator, including the checks before and after rollback. The shipped/rendered native service begins with shell admission.

Documentation limits admission to an initial Linux x86_64 rootful local candidate and explicitly leaves supported-profile acceptance and production unproven. The imported /home/sbarah/AGENTS.md is absent; the supplied no-long-dash rule was followed.
